tournament.name: OCC July Qualifier - Bracket B
tournament.description: OCC JULY SCHEDULE: Qualifier Brackets - July 17th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline July 17th @ 1200 GMT) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season. Round of 8 Finals - July 24th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline July 21st @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8. Top 8 Broadcast - July 25th
